sentences.en: You will be delayed for only thirty minutes at worst.

sentences.en: Chestnuts have to be boiled for at least fifteen minutes.
One minute earlier, and they could have caught the bus.
sentences.zh: 早一分钟的话他们就能赶上公交车了。
